text: That night: Holmes whispers that they must sit without light
why: They are in Helen's room after eleven at night, and Holmes whispers that they must sit without light (¶219-229).

text: Which room does the ventilator open into? — Holmes says that he, next door, would see a light through it
why: The story supports that the ventilator connects Helen's room to the doctor's room (¶208, ¶229), but Holmes does not say that he himself is next door. He says the doctor would see the light through the ventilator, so the label misattributes the speaker and subject.
